## ProofService.processProposal() method

Process a received [ProposePresentationMessage](./core.proposepresentationmessage.md)<!-- -->. This will not accept the presentation proposal or send a presentation request. It will only create a new, or update the existing proof record with the information from the presentation proposal message. Use [ProofService.createRequestAsResponse()](./core.proofservice.createrequestasresponse.md) after calling this method to create a presentation request.

<b>Signature:</b>

```typescript
processProposal(messageContext: InboundMessageContext<ProposePresentationMessage>): Promise<ProofRecord>;
```
